english.title: Taxi driver at authorised stand fail to display / produce badge when requested at Bristol Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), when operating as a taxi driver arriving at an Authorised Taxi Stand at Bristol Airport, namely **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), failed to

(A)_[display your badge to a]_
(B)_[produce your badge to a]_

(A)_[constable,]_
(B)_[traffic warden in uniform,]_
(C)_[airport official,]_

when requested to do so
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 7.7 and 3.4 of the Bristol Airport Byelaws 2012 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
